reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to SingleMall again
reauth_confirm.description: Home Assistant can no longer reach your SingleMall shopping list. Sign in again with the account you use on your phone.

abort.already_configured: This SingleMall account is already added.
abort.already_in_progress: A sign-in is already in progress.
abort.wrong_account: You signed in with a different account. Sign in with the account this list belongs to.

abort.not_allowed: This account is not allowed to use SingleMall. Ask the person who invited you, or sign in with the account you use on your phone.
abort.cannot_connect: SingleMall could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
abort.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Try again in a moment.
abort.missing_configuration: The sign-in for SingleMall is not available.
abort.missing_credentials: The sign-in for SingleMall is not available.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Timed out while preparing the sign-in page.
abort.no_url_available: Home Assistant has no address to come back to after the sign-in. See {docs_url}.
abort.oauth_failed: The sign-in could not be completed.
abort.oauth_implementation_unavailable: The sign-in for SingleMall is not available.
